_doc: src/shared/batteryfail.ts and the battery reaction of the browser simulator (priority P2 of the MVP). SIMULATED: a simplified imitation of what PX4 SITL did with a failed battery (docs/INVESTIGACION_FALLAS_PX4.md: warning, a hold of about 5 s, emergency landing, disarm about 2 s after the landing); this is NOT PX4 and not a real drone. With cfg.battery.react on (the default): at state of charge rem <= lowRem (0.15) a warning event; at rem <= critRem (0.07) a critical event and the automatic return (the `rtl` of the simulator: target (0, 0), altitude max(current altitude, cfg.rtlAltitude), phases climb / return / land, pilot off), unless the mode is already rtl or land; at rem <= emptyRem (0) a critical event, `emergency` is set, the sticks are released and: if the mode is land or the return is in its land phase the descent goes on, otherwise the vehicle holds where it will have stopped (holdHere, mode hold) for `params.emergencyHoldS` (5 s) and then lands (holdHere, mode land, event `landing`); the touchdown of an emergency leaves the vehicle armed `params.disarmDelayS` (2 s) more and then disarms (event `disarmed`). Each stage is raised once per flight (stage 0..3) and the three comparisons are made in that order within one step, so a charge that jumps past several thresholds raises all of them in the same step. The reaction runs at the END of every stepSim (after the charge was computed, also in the cut-motor model, where only the events are raised and no mode changes), and the mode it sets acts from the next step. While `emergency` and the vehicle is flying, every command but those in `emergency_allowed` is refused with `emergency_detail` (checked after the cut-motor refusals); a takeoff starts a new flight (stage, emergency and timers cleared). With react off nothing happens: no event, no mode change, the state is forgotten, and a pending disarm happens at once. A crash resets the state. Scenarios are scripts run on createSim(22, { battery }) in the format of flightsim.json (see its _doc) plus the ops `config` (setSimConfig with a partial `cfg.battery`; reply { reply: "config", ok, detail, event, code } with `code` only when refused) and `rem` (s.rem = value, a test hook; a row is recorded). `expect` lists, in order: rows (tokens of flightsim.json: the five heads, `state_columns`, `frame_columns`, then `react_columns`; "-" = null), replies and `{ event: severity, text, t }` records: the events taken with takeSimEvents after each stepSim step, BEFORE the row of that step. `final_cfg_battery` closes each scenario. `validate`: validateBatteryReact at its borders (`out` is "ok" or the error code, with its Spanish reason and range). `storage`: parseBatteryReact of the text kept under twinsight.sim.battery.react.v1 (only "0" turns it off). `texts`: the event texts for sample charges. The desktop port must reproduce every state number within `tolerance.state`, the frame numbers within `tolerance.frame`, the rpm within `tolerance.rpm`, the react numbers within `tolerance.react`, the event times within `tolerance.event_t` and every string, flag, code and reply text exactly.

scenarios.name: warning_15
scenarios.note: hover at 6 m, the charge is set to 15.5 %: the warning is raised when it drops to 15 % (about 4 s later) and nothing else happens; the vehicle keeps hovering

scenarios.name: critical_rtl
scenarios.note: a flight out to 30 m north / 20 m west at 8 m: warning at 15 %, then critical at 7 % starts the return (RTL of the model: climb to max(altitude, rtlAltitude), fly back, land); the landing disarms at once (no emergency)

scenarios.name: empty_emergency
scenarios.note: the pilot cancels the automatic return with hold and the charge reaches 0 %: hold for 5 s, emergency landing (the manoeuvre commands are refused, hold / land / faults are accepted), touchdown, 2 s armed, disarm; a new takeoff then gives a new battery

scenarios.name: react_off
scenarios.note: config battery.react = false ("Ignorar batería"): the same charge ramps as the other scenarios produce no event and no change of mode: the vehicle keeps hovering at 0 %, as the simulator always did

scenarios.name: toggle_in_flight
scenarios.note: off at 5 % charge (nothing happens), switched on in flight: the pending stages fire at once (warning, critical and the return); switched off during the emergency hold: it is cancelled, the vehicle stays in hold and is not disarmed at touchdown by the reaction

scenarios.name: custom_thresholds
scenarios.note: thresholds changed with setSimConfig (warning 30 %, critical 20 %, empty 3 %): the events and the return follow the new values; refusals of invalid thresholds change nothing

scenarios.note: no hook: hovering at 5 m from a full battery for 13 minutes: the warning (about 11.6 min) and the critical event with the return (about 12.7 min) arise by themselves; the landing disarms at once
